units.source_text: 原來我睡在本所木匠家的二樓房間。

en.t: Apparently I had been sleeping in a room on the second floor of a carpenter's house in Honjo.

units.source_text: 「你說過，‘財竭緣盡’，我還以為你是在開玩笑呢，你是真心話？

en.t: You said, 'When the money runs out, the bond is over,' and I thought you were joking. Did you really mean it?

units.source_text: 難怪這麼長時間不來找我，緣分一刀兩斷哪有那麼容易，

en.t: No wonder you stayed away from me for so long; cutting off a bond is not so easy.

units.source_text: 我賺錢給你花還不行嗎？」

en.t: Would it still be no good if I earned money for you to spend?
After that, she lay down and went to sleep too.

units.source_text: 天亮前，從她的口中第一次說出「死」這個字，對於人間生活，她似乎也已筋疲力盡，

en.t: Before dawn, the word death came from her mouth for the first time, and she too seemed exhausted by life among people.

units.source_text: 而我，一想到自己對人世間的恐懼、煩惱、金錢、地下運動、女人、學業，

en.t: As for me, when I thought of my fear of the world, my troubles, money, the underground movement, women, and my studies,

units.source_text: 真的無法再忍受著這一切活下去，於是隨口答應了她的提議。

en.t: I truly felt I could no longer endure all of it and go on living, so I casually agreed to her proposal.

units.source_text: 但當時我並沒有真正做好「死」的心理準備。

en.t: But at the time, I had not truly prepared myself for death.
